unit_definition_as_provided.definition: Top flow cytometry plots: x-axis labeled 'Annexin V FITC' — a fluorescence intensity channel, conventionally reported in arbitrary units, no explicit unit needed
Top flow cytometry plots: y-axis labeled 'PI PE' — a fluorescence intensity channel, conventionally arbitrary units, no explicit unit needed
Bottom bar graph: x-axis is categorical (PI −/+, Annexin V −/+ status), no unit needed
Bottom bar graph: y-axis labeled 'Percentage of cells (%)', unit (%) explicitly stated
Top flow cytometry plots: x-axis labeled 'Annexin V FITC' — fluorescence intensity channel, arbitrary units, no explicit unit needed
Top flow cytometry plots: y-axis labeled 'PI PE' — fluorescence intensity channel, arbitrary units, no explicit unit needed
Bottom bar graph: x-axis is categorical (PI−/Annexin V−), no unit needed
Bottom bar graph: y-axis labeled 'Percentage of cells (%)', unit (%) explicitly stated
x-axis lists categorical gene names/identities, no unit needed
y-axis lists categorical treatment groups (-DOX, +DOX 2d, +DOX 3d) with biological replicates, no unit needed
Color scale legend defined in caption: 'The color represents Z-Scores', and heatmap legend bar spans -1 to 1
x-axis lists categorical gene names (OCT4, SOX2, PRDM14, KLF17, DNMT3L / GATA6, SOX17, GATA3, HAND1), no unit needed
y-axis labeled 'Relative mRNA levels', a dimensionless normalized ratio (relative to -DOX control set at 1.0), which is a sufficient self-explanatory unit descriptor
